FROM REVOLUTION TO REPUBLIC

COTTAGE MEETINGS FOR TEENS

Now through April 15, 2025

Tuesdays at 11amPT/ 12pmMT/ 1pmCT/ 2pmET

What does freedom mean to you—and how can we ensure it thrives for future generations?

Just in time for the launch of our BRAND-NEW High School Credit-Earning Curriculum, Moms for America is thrilled to present
Cottage Meetings for Teens, hosted by Cassiopeia Fletcher, Executive Director of Membership & Education.

Building on Kimberly Fletcher’s foundational Cottage Meetings program, this interdisciplinary course weaves together American
history, classic literature, and the power of personal story to help teens explore the timeless themes of freedom and liberty.
Together, they’ll uncover the principles of representative government, individual rights, and religious freedom—core values
enshrined in the Declaration of Independence and the Constitution.

But freedom isn’t just a lofty ideal—it begins at home. By nurturing strong values and leadership within the family, we empower
teens to create freer communities, stronger states, and ultimately a thriving nation. This course is a powerful step toward
raising the next generation of leaders who understand, value, and protect the legacy of liberty.

Will your family take the first step in safeguarding freedom for the future?

Don’t miss this opportunity—sign up today to join the journey!

THE HEALING OF AMERICA

Now through May 27, 2025

Tuesdays at 5pmPT/ 6pmMT/ 7pmCT/ 8pmET

In the wake of the monumental 2024 election of Donald J. Trump, there’s no better time to embrace the principles of liberty and
take action to safeguard the future of our nation. Join Al & Juleen Jackson for Healing of America, a transformative 16-week
webinar series that explores the foundation of our republic, the structure of the Constitution, and the forces threatening our
freedoms. Discover practical strategies to overcome these challenges and heal America from the grassroots to the highest levels.

Through this series, you’ll gain a deeper understanding of the Constitution’s original intent, the ideals that make America
exceptional, and the steps needed to restore unity and strength across the nation. Whether you’re a seasoned patriot or new to
civic engagement, this is your opportunity to join a nationwide movement to preserve liberty for generations to come.

Don’t wait—reserve your spot today and be part of the solution. Together, we can protect and preserve our freedoms and rebuild
America’s greatness from the ground up.

name: Gabby Giffords
subject: Honoring the 17 lives lost in Parkland, Florida
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
#

Friends -
We come together today with heavy hearts to remember the tragedy at Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School in Parkland, Florida.
Exactly seven years ago today, students arrived at Stoneman Douglas thinking they’d have a pretty ordinary day. Besides taking part in Valentine’s Day celebrations like sharing cards, candy, and flowers with friends and significant others, it _should_ have been a normal school day.
But the afternoon of February 14, 2018 turned into an unfathomable nightmare for the Parkland community.
Students were evacuated from the school while a gunman opened fire with an assault weapon in hallways and classrooms. Police officers rushed in with their guns drawn to stop the assailant. Students and teachers texted friends and family members, unsure of their fate.
Fourteen students and three teachers were killed by the gunman in Parkland. Seventeen innocent lives were stolen in a matter of minutes. Seventeen families have a permanent empty seat at their dinner tables.
Unfortunately, we know that the tragedy in Parkland was not the end of school shootings in America. But it doesn’t have to be this way. There are real, commonsense gun safety solutions that can prevent these tragedies from happening. We just need our elected leaders to act.
I know that under the current administration, the road ahead for our gun safety movement feels uncertain. I’m not going to pretend that the next four years will be easy. But as I always say, the fights worth having rarely are.
We owe it to our children to keep up our work to end gun violence. No child should go to school with the fear that they may get shot in math class. And no parent should fear that if they send their child to school, they may not come home at the end of the day.
I hope today, you’ll join me in honoring the victims of the tragedy in Parkland with action.
[**If you’re able to, you can use this link to make a contribution to GIFFORDS PAC. Your donation to fuel our vital work towards a future free from gun violence would be especially meaningful today.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-feb25.m4Qwdn&refcode=em250214-1-b&t=1&akid=9989%2E3935704%2Ec4FjjT)
Thank you for taking the time to read this note and honor the 17 lives lost in Parkland seven years ago. Let this day serve as a solemn reminder that we cannot rest until we see a future where our children and our communities are safe.
With courage,
Gabby Giffords

Giffords PAC was started to support elected officials who step up to fight the gun violence epidemic. Thank you for standing with Gabby and the Giffords team.

I know that under the current administration, the road ahead for our gun safety movement feels uncertain. I’m not going to pretend that the next four years will be easy. But as I always say, the fights worth having rarely are. We owe it to our children to keep up our work to end gun violence. No child should go to school with the fear that they may get shot in math class. And no parent should fear that if they send their child to school, they may not come home at the end of the day. I hope today, you’ll join me in honoring the victims of the tragedy in Parkland with action. Thank you for taking the time to read this note and honor the 17 lives lost in Parkland seven years ago. Let this day serve as a solemn reminder that we cannot rest until we see a future where our children and our communities are safe. With courage, Gabby Giffords Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. www.Giffords.org

| Peter, “We have a responsibility to ensure that everyone gets a fair shot in life.” That’s what my parents taught me growing up, and I’ve carried that lesson every step of my life — from my time as a voting rights lawyer, to leading Wayne State Law School, to serving as Secretary of State. I’m running for Governor of Michigan to continue that work and make sure that every Michigan family has that fair shot. [If you’re with me, will you make a founding contribution of any amount today?](https://default.salsalabs.org/T7d4de9fd-d68c-4ba4-9856-d0780442fc2c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) I’m ready for this work. I’ve investigated radical extremist groups, taught civil rights and voting rights law, and I ran for Secretary of State to make sure government is efficient and transparent, that every voice is heard, and that every legitimate vote is counted. Some people didn’t like that very much — but I’ve never backed down from a tough fight. I’ve spent my life standing up to powerful interests, and I’ll keep standing up to any bullies or billionaires who try to deceive us, divide us, take away our rights, or deprive us of our opportunities. I’m running for Governor to truly make government work for everyone. We need transparent leadership, safe schools and neighborhoods, and good education and childcare. Every Michigander should be able to pay their bills, put food on the table, and take care of their families. [That’s what I’m ready to fight for as Michigan’s next Governor. Please, will you chip in $15 today to become a founding donor and help us launch this campaign?](https://default.salsalabs.org/T607d37a6-491a-4729-a752-be518a872eb2/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

Friend — Yesterday we learned that Senator Tina Smith is not running for reelection, meaning Democrats will have to win an open Senate seat in Minnesota.
So, we have a simple question for you today: **Should Ilhan Omar consider running to represent Minnesota in the Senate?[Tell us what you think:**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-feb25-senate/?source=em250214-1-120&akid=1515%2E791427%2EPnDMqg)

Team Ilhan

subject: Baaj Nwaavjo I’tah Kukveni - Ancestral Footprints of the Grand Canyon National Monument
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
I am calling on you to stand with me and defend our public lands.
#

Peter —
The Grand Canyon isn’t just a landmark. It’s sacred land to Arizona’s tribes. It protects our biodiversity, helps us fight climate change. It’s an essential part of our state and national history.
**Last year** , we celebrated the creation of Baaj Nwaavjo I’tah Kukveni – Ancestral Footprints of the Grand Canyon National Monument in Arizona, and the million acres it safeguards.
**A week ago** , Secretary of the Interior Doug Burgum released a directive to the Department of the Interior to reassess Baaj Nwaavjo I’tah Kukveni and all other national monuments designated under the Antiquities Act — with the goal of opening them up for oil, gas, and mining speculation.
**Today** , I am calling on you to stand with me and defend our public lands.
Trump and his administration tried this the first time he was in the White House. We stopped them back then, and we can do the same now.
Peter, please: [**Add your name and sign on here to support our public lands. It’s on us to step up and prevent the abuse and degradation of national monuments like Baaj Nwaavjo I’tah Kukveni.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/signup/pet_em_250214_public_lands/?source=em250214-1-120&akid=3715%2E734936%2EGOrBpU)

Ruben

This case is still going on in North Carolina, Team, and we have to spread the word because the media continues to ignore election theft in plain sight.
The North Carolina state Supreme Court stepped in to stop the certification of the election for a justice on their court , which is a huge breach of power and a clearly partisan action in a state where judges are affiliated with political parties.
For background: On Election Day, incumbent Justice Allison Riggs (D) was reelected by a slim margin of a few hundred votes. Her disgruntled opponent, GOP Judge Jefferson Griffin, sued for and received two separate recounts -- both of which increased Riggs' lead.
Now Judge Griffin has sued to remove 60,000 voters' ballots from the count , even though they've been validated in the recount. The state Board of Elections dismissed his request , but now his partisan, would-be colleagues -- the court has a 5-2 Republican majority -- have stepped in to adjudicate the election and possibly kick off one of their own.
Justices Anita Earls (D) and Richard Dietz (R) dissented while Justice Riggs properly recused herself, so the judicial stay on election certification was put in place by a 4-2, mainly party-line vote.
The bottom line is that the partisan Supreme Court is stepping into an election for one of their own members to try and reverse the results of the vote because their party didn't win. Opponents of voting rights are trying to steal this election in plain sight.
We've got to make sure everyone knows about this egregious intervention before these votes are stolen and the voices of the people are silenced. Will you chip in $25 or whatever you can right now to help us spread the word and defend these votes in North Carolina and so many other votes across the country? >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=021425_1&amount=25]

# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/102120999/528162251/1514584251?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MzRjZTJlNC1lZGVhLWVmMTEtOTBjYi0wMDIyNDgyYTk0ZjQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eBs_x2f1y5aOOlxwMWXZ7yCsYipvQmf-RHH_qykYnzw=)
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/102121001/528162254/1514584251?refcode=em-2.14.25-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MzRjZTJlNC1lZGVhLWVmMTEtOTBjYi0wMDIyNDgyYTk0ZjQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eBs_x2f1y5aOOlxwMWXZ7yCsYipvQmf-RHH_qykYnzw=) Hi Peter - It’s Shawn, Eric’s partner. By now, many of you know Eric’s story – fired for being himself and loving who he does, before finding acceptance in Rockford, and dedicating his career to those being forced to hide who they are. One story you may not know, from after the election, was when we met with President Biden to thank him for his service to the country. Joe gave us a warm embrace, and asked that we _“keep taking care of each other.”_ It’s Eric’s honor, not just to me but especially to women and LGBTQ people whose freedoms and rights are under attack in this country. And at this time, what we need is care and community. The fact is love _shouldn’t_ be political. And while some actors try to use divisiveness and scapegoating to sink their nails deeper into power, Eric leads with hope and unity, even when it’s not easy or popular. subject: Regarding the call for violence against me and Elon
body:
This is why I have to hire private security

| | | | [](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/a13s/?__vbtrk=Mjc1NDYxOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjc1NDYxOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
---
Friend,
I’m going to get straight to the point.
**Democrat Representative Robert Garcia went on CNN and issued a chilling call to violence against me and Elon Musk, calling for “ACTUAL WEAPONS” to be used against us.**
This is not new for me. Extremist Democrats have sent me countless death threats and I’ve been “swatted” too many times to count, but there is one big difference.
**_This is the first time a sitting member of Congress has gone on national television to issue a violent threat against me._**
I didn’t know much about Rep. Garcia before he went on national television to incite people to kill me and Elon Musk, but I did some digging and found out quite a bit.
Garcia, who proudly boasts about being the first gay former illegal immigrant elected to Congress, has been obsessed with me for quite some time.
**In just over two years in office,****_Garcia has sent over 60 emails to his supporters attacking me as a threat to democracy, a right wing extremist, and as a voice of hatred, lies, and conspiracies._**
But now his threats are being aired to every liberal zealot watching CNN, with absolutely no pushback from anchor Brianna Keller.
**This is exactly how President Trump’s would-be assassin Ryan Routh was radicalized, and with the rhetoric coming from the Democrats, I’m afraid it’s going to happen again.**
As a rank and file member of Congress, I don’t get a government security detail, I have to pay for that out of my campaign funds or my own personal.
**_[I’m asking for your help in the form of a donation to my campaign so that I can increase my security and keep myself, my staff, and my family safe](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/a13s/?__vbtrk=Mjc1NDYxOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjc1NDYxOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)_.**
I hate to ask, but I truly need the help right now.
[DONATE](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/a13s/?__vbtrk=Mjc1NDYxOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjc1NDYxOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
_Your support truly means so much to me, and I want to thank you from the bottom of my heart._
_In Liberty,_
[](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/a13s/?__vbtrk=Mjc1NDYxOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjc1NDYxOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
**Marjorie Taylor Greene**
[](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/a13s/?__vbtrk=Mjc1NDYxOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjc1NDYxOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
**_[P.S. Please don’t think for one second that these threats are going to stop me from fighting for you every single day. I’ve never been more committed to our mission](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/a13s/?__vbtrk=Mjc1NDYxOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjc1NDYxOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)_.**

At the end of 2014, medical researchers published a [shocking discovery](https://substack.com/redirect/ccad0819-8a51-44c9-bf50-8c20b9c611a5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg): that outcomes for high risk cardiac patients at hospitals were _better_ during periods when the top cardiologists were away from the hospitals for national cardiology meetings.
The researchers dug deeper, conducting a more in-depth study, and in 2018 published that[ follow-up study](https://substack.com/redirect/b1624c86-4b90-4ebe-a9e6-892020ad5bc6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) which came to the same conclusion: more patients admitted with cardiac arrest or high-risk heart failure survived longer when the so-called top doctors were absent from the hospital.
Which brings us to the question of the day: does meritocracy exist?
Lucas's Substack is a reader-supported publication. To receive new posts and support my work, consider becoming a free or paid subscriber.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9sdWNhc2t1bmNlLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.Gb0hNMYkAzJpVz-zdpLT-S-gp6irn_zDTfu-Rt7imGk?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=157147336)
In the above example, if meritocracy were real, who should be getting paid more? The top doctors, or the replacements who had better outcomes? Should the so-called top doctors be fired and replaced by their underlings, for "efficiency's sake?" Or should they have to at least switch positions?
There has been a lot of political fervor over workforce "merit" lately, and claims that the private sector is more "efficient" than the government because government decisions aren't merit based while the private sector is some sort of pure meritocracy.
A recent executive order even demanded [the restoration of merit to government service](https://substack.com/redirect/e261c9e1-d7e5-45cd-9cb6-b7b435652293?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Which supposedly the DOGE Bros and their groupies insist can only be done by outside minds like theirs, from the non-governmental world meritocracy reigns supreme, are needed to restore balance to the force.
Which, of course, anyone who has experienced rampant private sector nepotism and waste knows is complete BS. But it begs an examination of what meritocracy really is and if we find it in the competitive world outside of government or if, in fact, we might find it in the least likely place imaginable given all the rhetoric floating around: a government entity.
Back to our original cardiologist example, if a meritocracy should exist in any widespread field of business, it would be in medicine. Patient outcomes are tracked on a wide scale and the data is voluminous, both for physicians and for hospital systems. Not only that, but private health insurers, at least according to themselves, oversee the whole process by providing capital-based pressure and incentives that would necessitate merit-based decisions and drive efficiency and improved outcomes. Capitalist efficiencies on top of capitalist efficiencies! It's everything that the efficiency experts could dream up for creating a pure private sector meritocracy.
So, does it work? Do the doctors with the best outcomes get paid the most and are positive outcomes maximized? We can see from the study on cardiologists that it doesn't seem like they do in that particular instance. But what if we took it broader?
Around the same time that the cardiologist studies were being conducted, [medical researchers discovered](https://substack.com/redirect/962da009-3f51-43f4-9515-b123c0117698?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that patients treated by female physicians have significantly lower mortality rates and readmission rates than those cared for by male physicians. Follow-up research, just like it did with the cardiologists, [came to the same conclusion](https://substack.com/redirect/022ebbb2-9013-45f6-8451-455567792bb1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). In short, patients treated by female physicians experienced 1 fewer death per 417 hospitalizations and 1 fewer readmission per 208 hospitalizations. With about [35 million hospitalizations in the US every year](https://substack.com/redirect/9f41cca2-4cac-4d06-81ed-43f94e1072ab?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), that's a big deal.
Obviously, because of the vast amount of data available in medicine, the capital pressure from an entire insurance and industry, and the [rapid consolidation of healthcare firms through mergers and acquisitions](https://substack.com/redirect/c734a81c-640b-4141-b7d9-a19b1a6c7ceb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--something that CEOs and DOGE types constantly tout as increasing efficiency--there must be a significant difference in pay between male and female physicians. Market efficiency makes no other result possible, particularly at such a large scale, according to their science-y market religion.
And they are right, there is a difference! A pretty big one, in fact.
[Female physicians make approximately 24.6% less than their male counterparts](https://substack.com/redirect/221762d7-db05-4d3d-bf1c-136967165181?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) during their careers. And that's after adjusting for things like specialty, hours worked, years of experience, age, marital status, family structure, and research and clinical productivity.
Hmmm...
Thank God for market based meritocracy. But then again, if you're an efficiency expert I suppose you can always look at it through a different lens: the hospitals are getting a cut-throat rate on the better performing doctors!
Seriously, though, if pay doesn't match up with performance in a field full of educated professionals with easily accessible metrics, does anyone really believe that it matches up in more nebulous fields where insiders give their favorites non-stop hook-ups without an accountability system whatsoever?
There is no better example of accountability-free hook-ups than the board of Boeing hiring one of its own, Dave Calhoun, to "clean things up" as CEO when its planes were falling out of the sky. Which of course, he failed to do, [yet still raked in around $90 million](https://substack.com/redirect/a42330a3-b006-40de-a265-a3e1ad6d8408?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Ah, the sweet meritocracy of rewarding failure, of which ample CEO's give us great examples. How about the former CEO of Merrill Lynch, who was [rewarded with $159 million](https://substack.com/redirect/5fc283e2-b291-45e3-bc03-5619d5328a0c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for losing billions of dollars and costing his company millions in fines for playing around with subprime mortgages and plunging our country into the great recession.
For all the recent talk about private sector efficiency and accountability and complaints about how hard it is to fire a federal employee who is failing, I would bet it's a lot harder to fire a CEO than one of those federal employees.
If these guys were serious about merit and accountability, ironically, there might not be a better place to look than a section of the federal workplace: the US Military. In the Marine Corps everyone is rated, all the time, both on subjective and objective performance metrics. Everyone is also moved around from boss to boss and job to job so that you can't get screwed or hooked up by just one supervisor.
As for accountability, as a commanding officer in the Naval Service, you are held responsible for everything that happens in your command, oftentimes whether it was your fault or not. [16 Navy commanders were relieved of command in 2023](https://substack.com/redirect/1933e50a-7e20-4c10-a4ce-00a3271be798?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), for example.
That doesn't mean it's perfect, every system has hook-ups, but it certainly paints a clearer picture than anything I've seen for professional advancement proposed by the incoming private sector crowd.
Except, I should say, what they have implemented in aggressive service jobs like being an Amazon truck driver. They have a very intense solution there that I'm sure is quite effective: tracking every second of your time, watching you on camera, forcing you to [poop in bags in order to meet quotas](https://substack.com/redirect/c0222193-2001-45e7-813c-abdb63c5dfb3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and turning AI systems into your overlords.
That's the actual endgame of all of this.
Efficiency for these guys isn't about merit, no matter how many times they say it. There are thousands of federal employees that would welcome better and more meritorious systems. But so far it doesn't seem like that's what we are going to get.
Instead, what we have seen is a bunch of tech bros looking to instill fear, turn workers against one another, break unions, and extract every last drop of sweat and blood from those of us who work for a living in order to support the lifestyle and whims of an ownership class that is tired of government getting in its way.
Until they've succeeded in accomplishing that, I hope the worst thing that happens to you down at work is the bro who got his job because his dad was in the same frat as the boss explaining how important it is to bring private sector merit and efficiency to the jacked up government while he's placing his FanDuel bets and updating his fantasy roster.
Lucas

| **Here’s the truth:** Lots of commentators and talking heads said that when Donald Trump or Speaker Johnson suggested conditioning wildfire aid to California, they were just “all talk” with no intention of following through. The pundits said it would be way too vindictive and violate all kinds of norms to force California to adopt right-wing policies just to receive desperately needed relief for wildfire victims and first responders. **[Well... clean_body: | | | As Donald Trump and Elon Musk prepare to slash Medicaid and leave millions without coverage, we need Democrats in state legislatures. Donald Trump and Elon Musk have made it clear that Medicaid isn’t safe - and health care for millions of families hangs in the balance. Medicaid isn’t just a federal program. It’s backed by a combination of state and federal funds. And, if Republicans erase our 51-49 Democratic majority in the Virginia House of Delegates THIS NOVEMBER, they could drastically scale Medicaid back. Previously, I voted as a Delegate to expand Medicaid. Now, I need your help to expand our Democratic majority and show Donald Trump that we’ll defend our healthcare. I’m Elizabeth Guzman - a mom, social worker, and immigrant running in the red-to-blue, tossup Virginia House of Delegates 22nd District. But this year, it feels especially important to share my love and appreciation for Emily: my hardworking partner, my caring wife, and yes, my duly elected representative! So, for today, I’m celebrating our nearly 20 years together — and I’m not letting anyone steal our joy. [_**Can you help me deliver Emily a special Valentine’s Day gift by signing my card and leaving a note of appreciation for all her hard work?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/102127094/528176473/1192815316?contactdata=WB6wnGSELpX2nWF0NikZkkZ2zwWkuCvm0UW5nJ+gn8rM8ER0Tun0IfdyIOH4WvCikXrLSaFG8vCPUElEgLlk9E6WGm8ROF/4Aw4MNYevGCXptw939nuRbVr3zNK5On5+pAN/npQFuVBCJRy2ELHPdamdXEfO5aMtViOxMbFjqME=&refcode=RS_EM_EN_2025.02.14_VDay_Actives&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NzI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiYTU1MjYwMS1mNWVhLWVmMTEtOTBjYi0wMDIyNDgyYTk0ZjQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rQxhp4MoTtwgANPUSKv3CWB_PJBOtRyfoaXZ4bFG6oU=&emci=a385f53c-b6e8-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&emdi=ba552601-f5ea-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&ceid=23483442) **Signing the card and leaving a note is a small act, but it means the world to both of us.** It’s a scary time for the LGBTQ+ community, and especially for our trans friends and neighbors. We know firsthand how quickly things can change. When Emily and I first met, we didn’t have the right to legally marry in most of the country. It took years of activism and millions of people speaking out to expand marriage equality to all Americans. **Now, those basic rights are under attack — and some right-wing politicians are urging the Supreme Court to overturn _Obergefell v. Hodges_.** [_**Emily is working hard in D.C. to defend all our neighbors' rights, safety, and dignity, no matter what they look like or who they love. So, can you do me a small favor and sign my Valentine’s Day card for everything she does? clean_body: Please sign my Valentine’s Day card → | Peter, I’ll be honest: I don’t usually make a big deal about Valentine’s Day. But this year, it feels especially important to share my love and appreciation for Emily: my hardworking partner, my caring wife, and yes, my duly elected representative! So, for today, I’m celebrating our nearly 20 years together — and I’m not letting anyone steal our joy. Signing the card and leaving a note is a small act, but it means the world to both of us. It’s a scary time for the LGBTQ+ community, and especially for our trans friends and neighbors. We know firsthand how quickly things can change. When Emily and I first met, we didn’t have the right to legally marry in most of the country. It took years of activism and millions of people speaking out to expand marriage equality to all Americans. Now, those basic rights are under attack — and some right-wing politicians are urging the Supreme Court to overturn Obergefell v. Hodges. Thank you so much, and have a happy Valentine’s Day 💙 — Alison, Emily’s wife and proud constituent = | | Paid for by Emily Randall for Congress Emily Randall for Congress P.O. body:
We’ve had a lot of success in raising the resources we need to help candidates win their races in the past, but we’ve seen a real slowdown in our fundraising since election day.
#
Peter, Major General Paul Eaton, U.S. Army, retired and VoteVets Chair here.
As a team, we here at VoteVets made a huge call recently, and I’d like you to know about it.
Since her very first campaign, VoteVets has backed Abigail Spanberger. She’s one of our best — she represents everything this organization hopes to achieve. A strong, principled leader, stepping up at a moment when her state needs her most.
We knew we were going to back her campaign for governor in Virginia, but going into a period of uncertainty in the new Trump administration, we weren’t sure how much we could do. We’ve had a lot of success in raising the resources we need to help candidates win their races in the past, but we’ve seen a real slowdown in our fundraising since election day.
But, ultimately, we knew that this race was too important to stay on the sidelines. We made an important call, and decided to make the largest single donation to a candidate that we have ever made in the 20-year history of VoteVets. We’re all in for Abigail, and we’ve invested $500,000 to her campaign.
Now, whether or not we raise what we need to shore up our warchest is another question entirely. And, frankly, we’re being extremely honest with you now in the hopes that you will chip in and help us refill our coffers for the fights ahead.
The check is signed and delivered — the next part is up to you.
[**Can we count on you to make a donation to VoteVets? It’s essential that we face whatever comes our way on sound financial footing, and we’re hoping you can step up and make it happen.**](https://act.votevets.org/go/3042?c0=vv-pac-em-feb25-ab.ZXjAFv&refcode=em250214-1-f&t=1&akid=34167%2E3013755%2El6WhuB)

and missiles that will undoubtedly be used to slaughter more innocent
Palestinians. We have to do something NOW.

sale. Bernie has vowed to do everything he can to stop it, but he needs
more members of Congress to join him.

of more than 46,600 people in Gaza. And now Trump is doubling down:

want. After the election, Israel’s far-right Finance Minister ordered

incoming Trump administration will let them get away with it.

could take over the West Bank as he plans to kick out nearly two million
people from Gaza.

We HAVE to stop this illegal, dangerous, incredibly cruel plan. And the
best place to start is by finally putting an end to the endless flow of
U.S. weapons of war.

Bernie has led the way in the effort to put a check on U.S. weapons sales

clean_body: [ stdin# ][IMG] Peter Willis, As families across Gaza search for loved ones buried underneath the rubble, Trump is openly calling to expel Palestinians and turn the land into the “riviera of the Middle East” for his billionaire friends. This is ethnic cleansing of the Palestinian people, plain and simple. Trump then completely bypassed Congress by fast-tracking the sale of billions MORE weapons to Israel, all while vowing to "let all hell break out" in Gaza if the fragile ceasefire falls apart. Bernie summed it up perfectly: [ ][IMG] The LAST thing the Israeli regime needs is a massive new supply of bombs and missiles that will undoubtedly be used to slaughter more innocent Palestinians. We have to do something NOW. The fact is, the Senate could still step in and halt this latest arms sale. Bernie has vowed to do everything he can to stop it, but he needs more members of Congress to join him. [ ]That’s where we come in. Together we can show Congress that the public will not rest until Congress stands up to Trump and stops enabling Israel’s wars. Will you add your name? [ ]ADD YOUR NAME For 15 months, the U.S. government has provided Israel with an endless stream of billions of dollars of bombs and weapons, enabling the slaughter of more than 46,600 people in Gaza. And now Trump is doubling down: [ ][IMG] Trump’s ‘plan’ is right in line with what some far-right leaders in Israel want. After the election, Israel’s far-right Finance Minister ordered preparations for the annexation of the occupied West Bank, hoping that the incoming Trump administration will let them get away with it. Terrifyingly, those dreams are coming true – Trump also suggested Israel could take over the West Bank as he plans to kick out nearly two million people from Gaza. We HAVE to stop this illegal, dangerous, incredibly cruel plan. And the best place to start is by finally putting an end to the endless flow of U.S. weapons of war. Bernie has led the way in the effort to put a check on U.S. weapons sales to Israel, introducing resolutions to block arms shipments and getting historic levels of support from the Senate. While he didn’t get enough votes to win, momentum is building. And right now, with Trump throwing out one deadly idea after the next, this fight is more important than ever. [ ]Will you send a clear message that you will NOT sit by while Trump and Netanyahu push forward with plans to purge Palestinians from their land? _My name 's Marlin Stutzman._ I'm a 4th-generation farmer raising the finest Wagyu cows this side of the Mississippi. When I'm not herding cattle and hauling hay, I'm fighting the good fight in the People's House.

I ran for office because the Democrats AND even some Republicans have stabbed farmers like me in the back for as long as I can remember.

Ask any farmer - they'll show you the scars.

**I swear elites in DC think meat and produce *magically appear* at Whole Foods - not because farmers devote their blood, sweat, and tears to their trade. **

* China is buying up our farmland
* Democrats taxed us into oblivion
* Liberals want to replace beef with fake meat made from God knows what
* Politicians get rich at our expense
* We're left to pick up the scraps

My entire life is focused on bringing all that to a screeching halt. And the political class knows I can't be bought off or bribed. That's why they're mobilizing the powers-at-be to silence me so they can keep the gravy train rolling.

_And holding the line here will be tougher than a $3 steak._

The Secretary of Health and Human Services (HHS) is one of the most critical positions in the federal government, responsible for overseeing the nation's public health, social services, and healthcare systems. This role involves managing agencies like the CDC, FDA, and NIH, all of which are central to safeguarding the health and well-being of millions of Americans--as we learned first hand during COVID. And now, due to a near unanimous MAGA vote, that role has been handed to Robert F. Kennedy, Jr., a man with zero experience in health policy and an open hostility to medical science. Here's what you need to know about RFK, the health crisis we likely face with him at the helm, and how to better protect your health and safety. **Let 's Address This.**

## RFK Is An Anti-Science Extremist
Notwithstanding that RFK is not a physician or any man of science, he also brings with him zero experience in health policy. Even worse, his actions have led to mass death. Yes, Kennedy is an anti-vaxxer whose dangerous propaganda reportedly fueled a devastating measles outbreak in Samoa, resulting in unnecessary suffering of thousands and death of nearly 100 children.1 And just like Trump and Pete Hegseth (Trump's wholly unqualified Secretary of Defense), Kennedy too, is a credibly accused sexual predator.2 Elevating someone like Kennedy to oversee America's healthcare system, especially as up to 1000 Americans a day are still dying of COVID, is a surefire way to increase death and suffering.
As an aside, some are praising Mitch McConnell for voting against RFK. McConnell survived polio as a child and voted no on RFK because he recognized the anti-vaxxer propaganda RFK put forth. Here's the thing. There is no one person more responsible for Trump getting back to the White House than is McConnell. This hypocrite stood on the Senate floor and declared, "_There's no question, none, that President Trump is practically and morally responsible for provoking the events of the day_ "--then still refused to convict him of his violent treasonous act. Moreover, if the only time you vote against an injustice is when that injustice hurts you in particular, then you have no pace serving in public office. And let's not even begin to discuss McConnell's treachery in stealing SCOTUS seats, refusing to confirm Federal judges, and abolishing the filibuster when convenient for his agenda, but enforcing it when harmful to the Democratic agenda.
Everything we're seeing now is a result of McConnell's cruelty, cowardice, and hypocrisy. He's no hero. He's literally the one who enabled this, so please, praise him not. And because of McConnell's enabling, we face another potentially major crisis in accessing life saving mediations.
## The Potentially Major Impact On Our Meds
Few in corporate media have discussed the issue of medication access under RFK. Yet, this is an issue so significant that it could undermine the very access we all need to countless life saving medications to live. Fortunately, my colleague, fellow lawyer, and fellow writer [Elizabeth Booker Houston](https://open.substack.com/users/148732932-elizabeth-booker-houston?utm_source=mentions) thoughtfully explains this issue:
> The FDA has remained relatively untouched compared to other HHS divisions because over half of its funding comes from industry user fees, not congressional appropriations. This allows much of the FDA's operations to continue even during a government shutdown. These user fees come from industries like pharmaceuticals, tobacco, and medical devices, with the current terms lasting until 2027. Over-the-counter drugs are authorized until September 30, 2025, and tobacco fees require no reauthorization.
Booker Houston then explains the risk we face with RFK's confirmation:
> These agreements are negotiated between the FDA and industry because they are about more than just market access--they grant exclusivity rights tied to patents, making billions of dollars for companies. If Trump's administration, especially with figures like Robert F. Kennedy Jr., disrupts these carefully negotiated deals, expect a courtroom bloodbath. Big Pharma won't hesitate to fight back, and we'll see how much taxpayer money this "cash-poor" administration burns in legal battles against the industry's deep pockets.
Given how the Trump regime continues to cut vital programs and departments, I have zero confidence that they'll work to improve these deals, but rather, they'll destroy them altogether. So I say this as someone who already remains openly critical of our corrupt for profit system--the Trump regime's record is they will find a way to make it yet worse.
The United States already suffers the worse life expectancy in the developed world, the highest maternal mortality in the developed world (and 300% higher for Black and Indigenous women), and the highest infant mortality in the developed world (again, 300% higher for Black and Indigenous children). The MAGA decision to confirm RFK to HHS Secretary is a warning that our collective national health will get worse. Here are some actions you can take now to better protect yourself.
## Steps to Protect Your Health and Healthcare
The bottom line is we cannot reasonably rely on the Federal Government to enact good health policy with RFK at the helm of our health policy. This will require us to be that much more diligent to protect our own health and well-being. Here are some suggestions to consider:
1. Speak with your physicians now and ensure you have a clear path to access the medications you know you and your loved ones will need. Perhaps that means stocking up on critical medications as best as you can. Or, finding alternative locations (and countries) from which to procure that medication. Or perhaps finding alternative proven medications altogether. Whatever the case, speak with your physician now to ensure you have a game plan.
2. Speak with your insurance company to ensure you understand what changes are coming. The Trump regime is already working to defund and repeal the Affordable Care Act. Take the time to recognize the changes coming so you can plan ahead, and have the time to build a back-up plan as needed.
3. Wear a mask whenever possible, especially in crowded spaces. Prevention is better than cure. With COVID still devastating lives, and the flu with one of its worst years on record, a mask is literally life saving. Studies show that wearing a mask can prevent COVID infections by an astounding 83%.3
4. Get your COVID and flu shots regularly. And get the shots for your loved ones as well. The CDC reported in 2024 that flu shots decreased hospitalizations for people across all age groups by 50% or more.4
5. Contact your State representatives to push them to pass state based health coverage, especially as federal coverage is stripped away. Encourage your State government to fill in the gaps where federal coverage is lacking, especially as the Trump regime has instructed White House cabinet members to prioritize red states over blue states in funding access.
6. Eat healthy, exercise, get plenty of sleep, and drink plenty of water. This is just good advice in general in any given situation, and certainly applies now.

To be candid, we have a dangerous road ahead of us, and we must remain vigilant to protect our healthcare, and the health and well-being of our loved ones. Already in Gaines County, Texas, a measles outbreak has 24 confirmed cases, with 9 hospitalizations--all unvaccinated.5 Gaines County voted 91% for Donald Trump. A reminder that vicious diseases don't care what political party we belong to, or what part of the country we live in. Let us continue to uphold good health and good policy based on science and facts, even if our HHS Secretary won't.

Happy Valentine's Day! I thought I’d take a moment to share the love I have for Maryland’s Third District:
1. We are an engaged community. In the past few weeks my office has been proud to receive thousands of letters, calls, and visitors. You are an essential part of the legislative process and we really can’t do it without you.
2. The 44,000 qualified, passionate federal employees who serve our community and nation and call the Third District home.
3. The great history of our District’s Congressional representation. From personal heroes of mine like Barbara Mikulski (who I spent my Valentine’s Day lunch with today!) to titans of Maryland politics like Ben Cardin and more recently John Sarbanes – I am beyond humbled and excited to take up their mantle.
Thank you,
Sarah Elfreth

Peter, If you want to know why Donald Trump and unelected billionaire Elon Musk are working to dismantle our government from within, **follow the money.** Everything they’ve done so far has been about lining their own pockets at the expense of American families who work hard and play by the rules just to make ends meet. I’ve heard from Democrats, Republicans, and Independents alike in Vermont who are worried about the impacts of Trump shutting down critical agencies like the Department of Education and the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau. They’re also worried about Elon and his DOGE team accessing millions of Americans’ private information and data to make decisions about Treasury funds. **That’s why I’ve been speaking out against Trump and Elon’s plans to enrich themselves and leave working families behind.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/102135082/528200164/-1821282604?refcode=AU_RAB_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20250214_PM1_V1_S3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYmQwODhkNC1mZWVhLWVmMTEtOTBjYi0wMDIyNDgyYTk0ZjQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=cKd1Pe_Cs-c_KIxlLZj_M67535HmMtK65EkfTJjc2X0=&emci=faf4e9ca-feea-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&emdi=ebd088d4-feea-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&ceid=43402272)_I was proud to stand with the workers at the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau who have led the fight to protect hardworking Americans from big banks, scammers, and con artists like Trump and Elon._ [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/102135083/528200166/-1821282604?refcode=AU_RAB_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20250214_PM1_V1_S3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYmQwODhkNC1mZWVhLWVmMTEtOTBjYi0wMDIyNDgyYTk0ZjQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=cKd1Pe_Cs-c_KIxlLZj_M67535HmMtK65EkfTJjc2X0=&emci=faf4e9ca-feea-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&emdi=ebd088d4-feea-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&ceid=43402272)_Trump and Elon want to close the Department of Education to take money away from our kids and give it to billionaires. | | Everett Kelly sits atop the American Federation of Government Employees – the largest government union with dues collected from 800,000 workers – who are fighting tooth and nail to defend the “crown jewel” of the radical left......the deep-state. And, before President Trump even takes office, Everett Kelly and the other proponents of “unionized government” are making the rounds in the media attacking President Trump, attacking Elon Musk, attacking Vivek Ramaswamy, and conspiring with the outgoing Biden administration to extend collective bargaining agreements (an attempt to tie President trump’s hands on this issue for the next two years). **[**That is why the results of this NATIONAL SURVEY ON ENDING GOVERNMENT UNIONS will be tabulated and delivered to the Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE).**](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=fb87cf3c09ff47ebb9458b7245bd8c67&_e=ZaeQ2mv9tfZ2gThY9t7Kw8TgSHaDBtilm1iEYcuRO1vYgJI1w8KGg2Q2gIzGfy_uWjF04Kd5q4L1PeWXn0NQSFjX3ZDC1djlkMud2he1QzZccLXWvzF8FJhsnQmkHFnowYiETpNllAnz_6HkTI68F--SP7p3iz_02KT_9q1Q9DizYlSOLwD3QcTMoN8kgMViqx-I7UNBf0OXis0u6RqKNSiMtCjgkyEfv5Hwc1r5_MXUW6qfuR9u2P9AgXBsFPjujaZyRap15HwKiYwSo-U5X48UTXKFtB_yt0NUYtqX9dJSY9qCv1okpDxo04I8-W_uQ_sOmdN50Hh2gHHI_KbciSHKQxjCF34VVU-q58oW2wYEk-_AJnlMu1oTI82xGePu2Ykf3snUJxmJi_dhy-lGHJ3g226oeVqThnJ8H3mtJEk%3D)** Your participation is of the utmost importance.
---
* _Do you believe it’s acceptable that only 6% of federal employees show up in person for a full work week. And if you remove security guards, janitors, facilities and maintenance personnel, the number drops to 1%._
* _Did you know that in addition to 15 cabinet departments, there are over 2,000 federal agencies?_
* _Were you aware that leasing and maintenance costs for federal office buildings costs $15.7 billion per year?_
* _Or that the occupancy of these buildings is 12% on average?_

Donald Trump and Elon Musk think that by unleashing a barrage of rapid attacks on our institutions and progress, we’ll be paralyzed with shock and leave them unchallenged in their blatant power grabs.
Well, I’ve got news for them: I’m not the type to back down from a tough fight — especially when the lives of everyday Americans are on the line. Folks, today marks seven years since 17 students, teachers, and faculty were killed in a horrific shooting at Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School, my alma mater. This senseless act of violence shook our Parkland community to its core and forced unimaginable loss onto victims' families. In the aftermath, we turned that pain into action and passed the most comprehensive gun violence prevention and school safety legislation in Florida’s history. Although I’m proud of that legislation, I know it can never bring back those we’ve lost. As a husband and father, my heart goes out to the families who are remembering their loved ones today. Their pain is unimaginable – I'm thinking of them, and my family will continue to stand by them. But we know that while thoughts and prayers give comfort, they aren't enough to end gun violence. **That takes action.** **That’s why I introduced three bills this week to reduce gun violence:**
* **The EAGLES Act** establishes a national program on targeted violence prevention at schools, workplaces, and houses of worship via the National Threat Assessment Center.
* **The Single Application for School Safety Act** streamlines the grant application for schools to request federal support for school security.
* **The Measures for Safer School Districts (MSD) Act** directs schools to develop emergency response and parental notification procedures for certain threats and emergencies.

I’ve consistently fought for commonsense laws that prevent gun violence throughout my career, and I promise to always keep up that fight. Today, I hope the Parkland community will join me in wrapping their arms around the families who lost a loved one seven years ago. **We will continue to heal together.** Standing with you always, \- Jared

name: Chris Murphy (via Democrats.org)
subject: The power we have
body:
---
Derek, It’s been seven years since a shooter took 17 lives at Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School in Parkland, Florida. In the years since, we’ve organized and built a movement that finally rivals the gun lobby’s power in Washington. We’ve passed historic legislation that has saved lives. **But now that Trump is back in office, the gun lobby is staging a comeback — and it’s up to all of us to stop them.** In Trump’s first few weeks in office, he’s shown he cares more about gun industry profits than Americans’ safety. He disbanded the White House Office of Gun Violence Prevention. He also ordered a review of gun safety measures the Biden-Harris administration had enacted — including overwhelmingly popular actions that expanded background checks. Trump and his allies don’t care how widely supported or common sense a law is. They don’t care how many lives it saves if it stops the gun lobby from selling even one more gun. It took all of us working together for a decade to make federal gun safety legislation a reality in the first place, and it’s going to take all of us fighting back now to prevent the gun lobby from undoing all of our progress — including the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act we passed in 2022. To do it, we’ll need to elect Democrats at every level who are committed to keeping our communities safe. In 2024, mass shootings and gun deaths fell to their lowest level in five years. That’s a direct result of the changes we made to enact gun safety legislation — and it’s a reminder of the power we have when we fight for one another. Thank you for staying in this fight with me, and for taking the time to read this message. Every best wish, Chris Murphy
U.S. Senator, Connecticut

body:
MAGA is all in on dodgy lawsuits with big price tags as a handy weapon against the press. In fact, as Trump’s war against the news media intensifies, private lawsuits may have more of a freedom-killing role than government regulation.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/102138646/528209983/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYzAyMTExMzctMDVlYi1lZjExLTkwY2ItMDAyMjQ4MmE5NGY0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=i8iJrxIypncJPrVhIUL49CKXcGrSd4DOFDn4mONykPc=&emci=be211137-05eb-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&emdi=c0211137-05eb-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&ceid=14016711)
Hey, Peter,
At COURIER, we’ve spent a lot of time exposing Donald Trump's growing effort to silence journalists through costly, baseless lawsuits.
This week, journalist and COURIER National contributor Mark Jacob took a deep dive into how Donald Trump and his MAGA allies are using the legal system as a weapon against the free press.
We’ve included Mark’s full piece below—because this is an issue that deserves your attention and an example of the work are incredible teams are doing every day in this time of crisis for our country.
[**If you believe in fearless, fact-based journalism, COURIER could use your support. A contribution of $25—or whatever you can—helps us keep reporting the truth at this critical time.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/102138647/528209985/2081197767?refcode=20250214-MJ-Lawsuits&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYzAyMTExMzctMDVlYi1lZjExLTkwY2ItMDAyMjQ4MmE5NGY0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=i8iJrxIypncJPrVhIUL49CKXcGrSd4DOFDn4mONykPc=)
Thanks for being part of this fight,
The COURIER Team
* * *
**Trump pollutes our courts to punish the press **
**_If major media surrender to legal intimidation we're all losers_**
These days, Republicans have seen the light, led by the very litigious Donald Trump. MAGA is all in on dodgy lawsuits with big price tags as a handy weapon against the press. In fact, as Trump’s war against the news media intensifies, private lawsuits may have more of a freedom-killing role than government regulation.
**An alarming step came in December when ABC News settled Trump’s defamation lawsuit against the network and anchor George Stephanopoulos, giving Trump a note of regret published on its website, $15 million for his presidential library, and $1 million in legal fees.**
Trump had sued after Stephanopoulos said on the air that a civil jury had found Trump “liable for rape” in the E. Jean Carroll case. In fact, the jury determined he had committed sexual abuse, not rape. But a judge in the case had clouded the issue by saying Trump had committed rape “as many people commonly understand the word.”
The law is clear that public figures like Trump must prove there was malice or reckless disregard for the truth in order to win such lawsuits. That high bar would have given ABC a real advantage at trial, as would the judge’s reference to rape. But ABC folded anyway. Some speculated that ABC didn’t want to be in the position of covering Trump’s presidency while fighting him in court. **But the decision was undoubtedly made at the level of ABC parent Disney and reflected the trend in which major corporations have folded to Trump rather than risk his wrath.**
**[Support fearless reporting today!](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/102138648/528209987/-1581427288?refcode=20250214-MJ-Lawsuits&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYzAyMTExMzctMDVlYi1lZjExLTkwY2ItMDAyMjQ4MmE5NGY0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=i8iJrxIypncJPrVhIUL49CKXcGrSd4DOFDn4mONykPc=)**
Within days of the ABC settlement, Trump sued the Des Moines Register and its pollster over a survey just before the election that showed Kamala Harris leading him in Iowa. He ended up beating her there by 13 points, so it’s hard to see how the poll damaged him. But Trump sued anyway, alleging violation of the Iowa Consumer Fraud Act.
The Register is owned by Gannett, the nation’s biggest newspaper chain. Will Gannett go the route of ABC and settle even though it’s a stupid lawsuit? Perhaps.
**These nuisance suits can drain the legal budgets and patience of media organizations. Trump is still pursuing a lawsuit he filed in 2022 against the Pulitzer Prize board for honoring journalists who covered his 2016 campaign.**
The most closely watched Trump lawsuit against the media targets CBS News. In November, Trump sued over a “60 Minutes” interview with Kamala Harris, alleging that the editing caused “malicious, deceptive, and substantial news distortion.” This is ridiculous. News outlets cut things out of interviews all the time for a variety of reasons. It’s not a conspiracy. It’s editing.
Trump’s lawyers went judge-shopping, filing their suit in the Amarillo, Texas, court where Trump-appointed extremist Matthew Kacsmaryk rules. The suit offers what the New York Times called “a largely untested interpretation of a Texas law that prohibits deceptive trade practices.”
**Despite the weakness of Trump’s case, Paramount and CBS are considering settling, which would be a grievous act of self-vandalism. They would be sliming their most prestigious news show, “60 Minutes.”**
Not to be outdone by Trump, co-president Elon Musk is pursuing his own outrageous lawsuit against a news organization. He has sued Media Matters for America, which tracks right-wing extremism in the media, over its report that ads for major companies appeared on Musk’s Twitter/X next to pro-Nazi content. Musk accused Media Matters of misconduct in its investigative reporting, but there’s no doubt that Musk welcomes Nazis on X.
**[Contribute now to support journalism like this ➡️](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/102138649/528209989/-1581427288?refcode=20250214-MJ-Lawsuits&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYzAyMTExMzctMDVlYi1lZjExLTkwY2ItMDAyMjQ4MmE5NGY0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=i8iJrxIypncJPrVhIUL49CKXcGrSd4DOFDn4mONykPc=)**
These lawsuits by Trump and Musk are private, but they carry government threats with them. After Musk sued Media Matters, the right-wing attorneys general of Texas and Missouri launched investigations of Media Matters.
**Then there’s the clout being wielded by Brendan Carr, one of the authors of Project 2025 and now chair of the Federal Communications Commission. Carr, a diehard Trump loyalist, has significant leverage over CBS. The network’s parent, Paramount, is seeking to merge with Skydance in a deal that requires FCC approval. That’s a key reason many observers expect Paramount to settle the CBS suit – because of an unrelated business deal.**
Carr has already muscled into the Trump-CBS dispute by demanding and getting a full transcript and video of the Harris interview. CBS said the full footage showed the broadcast was not “doctored or deceitful.” But facts aren’t important to the right wing; creating an air of suspicion is. Trump raised the price tag on his lawsuit from $10 billion to $20 billion after the release of the transcript – and added Paramount as a defendant.
Then there’s the looming threat against the Supreme Court’s 1964 New York Times vs. Sullivan decision, which made it harder for “public figures” to win defamation cases. Without that protection, large segments of the press would be unwilling to report negatively about very rich and powerful people. Just a few days ago, Trump megadonor Steve Wynn petitioned the Supreme Court to revisit Sullivan – an idea that corrupt Justice Clarence Thomas has long urged.
When federal prosecutors charged Trump over the Jan. 6 insurrection and his theft of classified records, Republicans called it “lawfare,” as in legal warfare. It wasn’t. In fact, the jury determined he had committed sexual abuse, not rape. name: Jay Jones
subject: Folks, I truly love Virginia
body:
jayjones.com [jayjones.com]

Folks, happy Valentine’s Day! On a day all about love, I want to explain how my love for Virginia is guiding my campaign to be its next Attorney General.

I am a lifelong resident of Hampton Roads. Virginia is my home and my family’s home for generations. And it’s the place where my wife and I have chosen to raise our children.

I love Virginia, and I want to make sure that it’s a place that loves all its residents in kind – and that’s why I am running to be Virginia’s next Attorney General.

As Attorney General, I will make Virginia an even greater place to live by challenging shady landlords, price gougers, and other bad actors who are threatening Virginians’ economic security.

I will fight actions from corporations, our state leaders, and the Trump administration that will damage our environment. Virginia is a beautiful state with a rich history, and I won’t stand by and let greediness destroy that. I want my children, and all young Virginians, to grow up without the health and safety effects of pollution and climate change.

I will work to make sure that everyone in Virginia will have the chance to thrive. As a descendent of slaves, I still see the ways in which our legal system discriminates against communities of color. I will work to ensure that any discriminatory state codes are modernized so that all Virginians have true equality under the law.

If you love Virginia like I do, will you please make a special Valentine’s Day contribution to my campaign? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/loc_jones_em_q12025]

Folks, it’s time Virginia had an Attorney General that would put its people at the center of their decisions, like I will.
Please help me win in November by making a donation today. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/loc_jones_em_q12025]

Thank you.

I am a lifelong resident of Hampton Roads. Virginia is my home and my family’s home for generations. And it’s the place where my wife and I have chosen to raise our children. I love Virginia, and I want to make sure that it’s a place that loves all its residents in kind – and that’s why I am running to be Virginia’s next Attorney General. As Attorney General, I will make Virginia an even greater place to live by challenging shady landlords, price gougers, and other bad actors who are threatening Virginians’ economic security. I will fight actions from corporations, our state leaders, and the Trump administration that will damage our environment. Virginia is a beautiful state with a rich history, and I won’t stand by and let greediness destroy that. I want my children, and all young Virginians, to grow up without the health and safety effects of pollution and climate change. I will work to make sure that everyone in Virginia will have the chance to thrive. As a descendent of slaves, I still see the ways in which our legal system discriminates against communities of color. I will work to ensure that any discriminatory state codes are modernized so that all Virginians have true equality under the law. Team, We have real issues to address. Housing and grocery prices are too high for working families. Our public infrastructure needs to be improved. And we have much more work to do to ensure our students receive a quality public education. Instead of working with Democrats to solve our state’s most pressing issues, Arizona Republicans are more focused on pandering to Donald Trump. They’re spending more time attacking LGBTQ+ rights, DEI, and “wokeness” in schools rather than working to move our state forward. **Democrats are ready to do the real work.** We’re fighting around the clock to lower the cost of living for hardworking Arizonans, protect our fundamental freedoms, and keep our communities safe, healthy, and secure. Like dozens of other states, Indiana has for decades had nonpartisan elections for school board elections. Hoosiers understand the decisions made at the school board-level are about community and collaboration, not partisan division. That’s why Democrats are fighting to keep the system we’ve had and that works for Indiana with nonpartisan school board elections. Hoosiers expect their elected officials to listen to them, not to party bosses. By keeping school boards nonpartisan, we can avoid the partisan games that take place on the state and federal levels. Bills to add partisan affiliation to these races are moving in both the House and the Senate, and we will continue to keep you updated on the latest in the Kernel and on our social media channels. ****_Federal Prosectors Allege Taxpayer Dollars Were Funnelled to Republican Campaigns Through Virtual School_ **[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/102140570/528216481/-541836942?s=46&t=Dj7-Y210GYDWXG21xFaxCQ&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZTU1ZGRmMS0wN2ViLWVmMTEtOTBjYi0wMDIyNDgyYTk0ZjQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xzGnKepfD9s2-l30dULGxMyYjYU1yBWrAp5hxiKVFCk=&emci=35ea8be4-00eb-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&emdi=fe55ddf1-07eb-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&ceid=4925535)**[Share INDems](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/102140571/528216482/-541836942?s=46&t=Dj7-Y210GYDWXG21xFaxCQ&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZTU1ZGRmMS0wN2ViLWVmMTEtOTBjYi0wMDIyNDgyYTk0ZjQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xzGnKepfD9s2-l30dULGxMyYjYU1yBWrAp5hxiKVFCk=&emci=35ea8be4-00eb-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&emdi=fe55ddf1-07eb-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&ceid=4925535) Federal prosecutors released new documents relating to their investigation of the Indiana Virtual School this week, and they allege that up to $40,000 worth of taxpayer dollars meant to help students were actually redirected to a number of campaign accounts supporting Indiana Republicans in the 2018 elections. Hoosiers deserve better, plain and simple. This is a blatant misuse of taxpayer funds, and another reason why we should be fully funding our local public schools, where over 90% of Hoosier students attend, first. ****_Each week, the State Party will highlight key policy from Democrats at the Statehouse or across the state. Democrats deliver a better future for Hoosier families, and we urge you to share this information with your networks._ **[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/102140572/528216483/1715506285?s=46&t=Dj7-Y210GYDWXG21xFaxCQ&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZTU1ZGRmMS0wN2ViLWVmMTEtOTBjYi0wMDIyNDgyYTk0ZjQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xzGnKepfD9s2-l30dULGxMyYjYU1yBWrAp5hxiKVFCk=&emci=35ea8be4-00eb-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&emdi=fe55ddf1-07eb-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&ceid=4925535)**

Derek — In a
few moments, I’m going to explain why the hyper-politicization of the
Justice Department has a dramatic, negative effect on everyone in this
country.

But to properly demonstrate the impacts, I want to tell you a story first:

One of the unique cases I took on as a young Assistant U.S. Attorney
involved a corporation that hired toxic waste haulers to smuggle hazardous
materials across the border into Mexico.

The U.S. government had just put in place additional environmental rules
to protect our drinking water and our communities. This made it much
harder to dump chemicals and toxic waste in the U.S. and was critical for
water safety.

A U.S. company paid the haulers to smuggle the waste across the border and
dump it in Mexico. We found dozens of drums that used to carry this
hazardous waste there, from paints to flammable solvents and other toxic
materials.

We also intercepted a fair amount of other cargo intended to be dumped.
Unfortunately, people living in these areas emptied the drums, filled them
with water, and washed clothes in them. It was dangerous, and we needed to
take action.

As an Assistant U.S. Attorney, I took on this waste dumping corporation —
and won.

It was the first federal prosecution for across-the-border toxic waste
dumping ever. It set an important precedent: that no company, big or
small, could avoid accountability when harming our planet and putting the
health of communities at risk, both at home and abroad.

But if the Trump Administration succeeds at its goal of turning the
Justice Department into a tool to go after political enemies, then the
department might not be able to pursue cases like this. And might even
look the other way.

If Attorney General Pam Bondi directs young prosecutors to target Trump’s
rivals, then the Justice Department may not have the capacity to go after
corporations breaking the rules and putting people in harm’s way.

If the EPA rolls back climate protections, millions of Californians and
Americans are at risk of toxic material exposure.

If Trump and Musk lay off career civil servants, we lose decades of
expertise in vital departments that keep our federal government running.

All of this is at risk because Donald Trump wants to use the federal
government to go after his opponents. He views the Justice Department as
his own legal counsel — and we can’t let him.

Derek, I will work
to make sure the Justice Department remains a neutral arbiter of the rule
of law. I will do everything I can to make sure the Justice Department
pursues exactly what it’s meant to — justice.

clean_body: [ ]Adam Schiff for Senate Derek — In a few moments, I’m going to explain why the hyper-politicization of the Justice Department has a dramatic, negative effect on everyone in this country. But to properly demonstrate the impacts, I want to tell you a story first: One of the unique cases I took on as a young Assistant U.S. Attorney involved a corporation that hired toxic waste haulers to smuggle hazardous materials across the border into Mexico. The U.S. government had just put in place additional environmental rules to protect our drinking water and our communities. This made it much harder to dump chemicals and toxic waste in the U.S. and was critical for water safety. A U.S. company paid the haulers to smuggle the waste across the border and dump it in Mexico. We found dozens of drums that used to carry this hazardous waste there, from paints to flammable solvents and other toxic materials. We also intercepted a fair amount of other cargo intended to be dumped. Unfortunately, people living in these areas emptied the drums, filled them with water, and washed clothes in them. It was dangerous, and we needed to take action. As an Assistant U.S. Attorney, I took on this waste dumping corporation — and won. It was the first federal prosecution for across-the-border toxic waste dumping ever. It set an important precedent: that no company, big or small, could avoid accountability when harming our planet and putting the health of communities at risk, both at home and abroad. But if the Trump Administration succeeds at its goal of turning the Justice Department into a tool to go after political enemies, then the department might not be able to pursue cases like this. And might even look the other way. If Attorney General Pam Bondi directs young prosecutors to target Trump’s rivals, then the Justice Department may not have the capacity to go after corporations breaking the rules and putting people in harm’s way. If the EPA rolls back climate protections, millions of Californians and Americans are at risk of toxic material exposure. If Trump and Musk lay off career civil servants, we lose decades of expertise in vital departments that keep our federal government running. All of this is at risk because Donald Trump wants to use the federal government to go after his opponents. He views the Justice Department as his own legal counsel — and we can’t let him. Derek, I will work to make sure the Justice Department remains a neutral arbiter of the rule of law. I will do everything I can to make sure the Justice Department pursues exactly what it’s meant to — justice. [ ]Please, if you can, chip in $10 or anything you can afford to support my work. Friend ,
Happy Valentine’s Day! ❤️
Today, as we celebrate love in all its forms, we can’t help but reflect on the state of our country.
We know tuning into the news is hard right now. With the constant barrage of discriminatory and senseless executive orders coming from the White House, it can feel easier to be fearful or angry, rather than generous or loving.
Every day, we’re hit with another wave of cruelty from Donald Trump and his allies — whether it's gutting protections for workers, dismantling diversity and inclusion initiatives, or pushing a mass deportation plan. They want us to feel powerless. They want us to give up.
But here’s the thing: Lateefah isn’t backing down.
This month alone, she stood outside the Department of Education, demanding answers from the administration about their attacks on our public schools. She joined workers from the CFPB to push back against Trump’s attempts to dismantle the one safeguard protecting working people from corporate greed. And alongside the House Oversight Committee, she launched an investigation into Trump himself, because accountability matters. She’s using every tool at her disposal to push back against hate.
We know it’s a scary time, Friend, but here’s the truth: love is stronger than hate. It’s action. It’s standing up, speaking out, and fighting for a country where every person — no matter their race, gender, or income — has dignity and opportunity.
And we won’t let hate win.
So today, instead of chocolates and flowers, let’s invest in a future rooted in love, justice, and equity. We have exactly two weeks until our end-of-month deadline. Team — We know so many are overwhelmed and exhausted after just the first few weeks of the Trump administration — but that's what they're counting on. They're counting on flooding us with so many awful, discouraging actions that Democrats lose hope, tune out, and give up. We can’t. We need you to recommit to this fight with us to ensure Trump’s alarming executive actions don’t go unanswered. Attacks on workers’ rights and birthright citizenship, pardoning criminals that assaulted police officers, and rolling back American energy leadership — these actions hurt families, threaten our democracy, and endanger our communities. Too much is on the line to sit on the sidelines, team. Martin and other Senate Democrats are doing everything they can. body:
Every pilot, every airline, every shipping company in the country depends on the weather forecasting data NOAA provides through the National Weather Service with their sensors and satellites.
#

Hey everybody — it's Mark Kelly.
Elon Musk’s underlings are targeting the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration. Current and former NOAA officials have been told to expect a 50% reduction in staff and a 30% reduction in funding.
Again, and I can’t emphasize this enough: Elon Musk has no authority to dictate or impose these cuts. Congress authorizes and appropriates NOAA’s funding, and neither President Trump or Elon Musk have the authority to cut it unilaterally.
But beyond that, I’m a pilot and someone who sailed on a merchant ship across the oceans. Gutting NOAA is absolutely nuts. Every pilot, every airline, every shipping company in the country depends on the weather forecasting data NOAA provides through the National Weather Service with their sensors and satellites. Every American, from Hawaii to Maine, needs that data to prepare for adverse weather conditions like hurricanes and tornadoes. Farmers need it to raise their crops. Ship captains need it to chart their courses.
The dollars Musk and the Trump Administration might save pale in comparison to the collateral damage we would incur by gutting this agency.
I am going to use every lever of power at my disposal as a United States Senator to defend NOAA from Elon Musk and the White House as they try to slash our country’s vital infrastructure to the bone.
But I can’t do it without you.

Hi Friend,
Since it's Valentines' Day, let's get to the heart of the matter.
From coast to coast we're talking to Americans every day. Many of us continue to experience a range of emotions over Trump, the assault on our institutions of government, and the hate that's being unleashed on those not drinking the MAGA cool-aid.
Some still cry. Many remain angry over the election. Some are simply giving up and hunkering down.
Not us.
Valentine's Day is a moment to express our love for our significant others. But this year, it should also mean love for our country and a renewed commitment to fight for it.
That means fighting for the essential institution charged with maintaining "Equal justice under law."
But the Supreme Court has been perverted into an extension of Trump. The MAGA majority on SCOTUS created immunity from prosecution for Trump and stands ready to put their seal of approval on every unconstitutional move he makes.
And they will be there well after he's gone!
Unless we act now!
Term Limit the Court is working with 75 members of Congress, including Adam Schiff and Hakeem Jeffries, to end lifetime appointments to SCOTUS and enact 18-year term limits.
We're back at work raising what's needed to back candidates for the House and Senate pledging to support the TERM Act.

And today, we just got a massive win: With the courts ruling, the National Institutes of Health (NOH) have resumed issuing grants. **Just hours after the decision, I was informed that Children's Hospital Los Angeles will receive a $200,000+ Research for Mothers and Children Grant — an investment that had been illegally frozen.** This is just the start. Believe me, team — I know the tough challenges that working families are going through. While both my girls are all grown up now, I’ll never forget the early days of juggling a newborn, a mom with cancer, and a full-time job. It was _a lot_ — and the understanding that people all across Michigan are facing those same struggles is what drove me to enter public service. From my time in the State Senate to my service as Governor of Michigan, I’ve fought like hell to deliver meaningful results for working families. We’ve expanded Medicaid, increased the minimum wage, made the biggest investment in education _ever_ , created thousands of good-paying jobs, defended our fundamental freedoms, and so much more. Public service to me isn’t just talk. _My name 's Marlin Stutzman._ I'm a 4th-generation farmer raising the finest Wagyu cows this side of the Mississippi. When I'm not herding cattle and hauling hay, I'm fighting the good fight in the People's House.

* Liberals want to replace beef with fake meat made from God knows what
* Politicians get rich at our expense
* We're left to pick up the scraps

My entire life is focused on bringing all that to a screeching halt. And the political class knows I can't be bought off or bribed. That's why they're mobilizing the powers-at-be to silence me so they can keep the gravy train rolling.
