## Son Saves Father's Life Twice with Donations
Joshua Andrew, 23, [has saved his father David's life twice](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx80DFuxCAQQNHT4A6LGQOOC4o07jZtSouYwZ6EhZUha_n2UXKAXOB_6b3flpvnxHl783dycYtLi2VBhUYqlKCX4Dldi-6Ci0RIQ0cOxmEy1sCL6XZnR6MALKCHSX9YCNO4hoAB1mBHGKhj91tTCBoVTmh6PSg0nhSs0-StIqEVBW7l6D8L57ZTTFd50tGv5d4lt7f2qGJ4FTgLnM_z7I9y-RQPoj7vtf_-EjhnOqvAuZZc5caxyZ2rjL7tdMhKa8lBJo4kq39y3mQo2TcuuTtceJycElc7Cq22u-f0923_WTwd_gQAAP__2VxjuQ)--first by donating bone marrow during his cancer treatment and now by giving him a kidney. David, 57, developed chronic kidney disease due to chemotherapy he underwent a decade ago for non-Hodgkin lymphoma. During his initial treatment, Joshua donated bone marrow, which played a crucial role in his father's recovery from cancer. When David's kidney function recently declined, Joshua returned from Australia to donate a kidney, which was a perfect match. Now recovering at home, David and his family have expressed deep gratitude, with Joshua's mother calling his selflessness "[difficult to put into words.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx8z7GOhCAUheGngW4MXEGkoNjGbrbd0lzxomxQDJIx8_Yb9wGmO8lJvuT_eY5PjCnuyzdu5MISxhryCAL0Q8BDqnHGmN6j4rMLREAtJydNa3WnZa_56jrE3ga0LYZJSqFRaK07OXs0xmgKPLpbEyAVCLCgG9UK0EhCemuxE8SUoDnWXJrfHPe6Ukjv_KLS-Lzx5NZaj5O1XwwGBsN1Xc00-ftjMOx0nQwGLDX6RPf0Rm2l78shKfPi5uOKKcWzM0yJZcOY_tX6qfTl4C8AAP__IRVWKQ)"

#
Friend of Life,

Did you know that America's most popular diaper brands, including Huggies, Pampers, Hello Bello, and Honest Co., all support abortion?

This is peak irony. Brands that provide a necessity for babies also financially and/or publicly support an act that intentionally kills innocent children in the womb.

As pro-life people, we can do something to put a stop to this.

**Live Action is hosting a diaper drive with EveryLife -- the first pro-life diaper company -- to help mothers and their babies in need.**

If you're tired of supporting brands that don't align with your pro-life values, you can do something now to help women AND support a pro-life business.

**Your gift of just $50 will provide six packs of EveryLife diapers to a mom who is considering abortion or is facing a crisis and help her embrace life. We are searching for 100 people who can give before midnight so we can get diapers to local pro-life pregnancy centers nationwide. **
[](https://e.nl.vintagetec.com/re?l=D0I2xuec9lIteknop5I8ITm75itffj&s=LBJKEANNFOOHIKNE)
Is this something you can do? Here's your secure link to give: **[https://give.liveaction.org/send-a-box-of-diapers-to-a-mom-in-need/](https://e.nl.vintagetec.com/re?l=D0I2xuec9lIteknop5I9ITm75itffj&s=LBJKEANNFOOHIKNE)**

EveryLife prides itself in being a pro-life company that uses premium materials for their diapers-- and better yet, EveryLife promotes the message that every baby is a miracle from God who deserves to be loved, protected, and supported.

Your gift will send a box of diapers to a local pro-life pregnancy clinic so that moms days away from a potentially life-ending decision can receive the practical support they need to choose life.

There's only a few hours to go and we haven't been able to reach our goal of 100 partners before midnight. Please consider **[donating right now before this opportunity expires.](https://e.nl.vintagetec.com/re?l=D0I2xuec9lIteknop5IaITm75itffj&s=LBJKEANNFOOHIKNE)**

Thank you in advance for standing with us against big abortion and equipping moms to choose life.

For Life,

Lila Rose

name: Kristen McDonald Rivet
subject: How’s this for a Valentine’s Day surprise? 🎁
disclaimer_text: paid for by gutting life-saving services, like Medicaid
body:
|
#

While couples across Michigan are picking out chocolates and flowers for their sweethearts, House Republicans are handing out a Valentine’s Day gift of their own:**An $880 billion hand out to billionaires paid for by gutting life-saving services, like Medicaid.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/102145492/528232559/-1606559029?refcode=em-2.15.25-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjAyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwYmQzNDYwYi0xM2ViLWVmMTEtOTBjYi0wMDIyNDgyYTk0ZjQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=LKDOeLUDwTWwG4kNhetFbgCo9oaQ5uZRy7kdSbrkdFE=)
Look, $880 billion isn’t just a line item in a budget.

We’re talking about a lifeline for seniors struggling to afford their prescriptions, working parents trying to cover their kids' doctor visits, and rural hospitals fighting to keep their doors open.

**Here in Mid-Michigan, 80% of our jobs pay less than $50,000 a year, so this isn’t an abstract policy fight. These cuts are a direct attack on our community, and I won’t stand for it.**

Celebrating Oregon’s Heritage

| | | | [ ](https://oregon.gop/)
---
| | Friend, February 14th is more than just Valentine’s Day – it’s the day Oregon became the 33rd state to join the Union in 1859.
---
| | [ ](https://links.infooregongop.com/els/v2/~ye9Q7mYAZJe/Z3hadmtWeC9SbUZuK3luRDRKczcyTFJQOG5nc3pSNFBNalJMVnNSQVJ6SitWWXB0RkE0MlpDMmdRS3g4TllyUHFFOWplVUk3eGlnUkhFcGsvQ3hGWG94WUgreEFvb3RIeTNybEZBbjl2QzA9S0/)

| | For 165 years, Oregon has been a symbol of exploration, innovation, and resilience, shaped by the pioneers who blazed the Oregon Trail and the hardworking communities that built our great state. From the rugged coastlines to the fertile Willamette Valley, from the high desert to the towering Cascades, Oregon’s diverse landscapes reflect the strength and character of its people. Our state has played a critical role in America’s history, from agriculture and timber to trade and technology. Today, we continue to work to ensure a future for Oregon’s small businesses, manufacturing, agriculture, and innovative technology, while preserving the natural beauty that makes Oregon unique. As we celebrate this milestone, let’s honor Oregon’s past while working together for its future. **The pioneering spirit that brought settlers westward still lives on in those who fight for the values of liberty, opportunity, and prosperity in our state. ** Happy Birthday, Oregon! May we always stay true to the independent spirit that defines us. Thank you, Oregon GOP

name: Sam Weinberg
subject: did we make Project 2025 delete their account?
body:
| |
---
A funny thing happened when we called out OMB Director Vought's naughty social accounts... | [View in browser](https://jjajxo.clicks.mlsend2.com/td/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEyODY4MDcsXCJsXCI6MTQ2MzQ1MzMyNjg2NDU2MDU2LFwiclwiOjE0NjM0NTM5NTk2ODAxNzg0N30iLCJzIjoiOTVlOTYwZDE1ZTQwN2M3MiJ9)
| |
---
Okay so today's Valentine's Day, we're all supposed to be in love and everything, I get it.

But Friend, I really think some people need to draw the line on public displays of affection. For instance, **maybe the recently-confirmed Office of Management and Budget Director shouldn't use his official Instagram account to follow p🩷rn accounts.**

|
---
| [ ](https://jjajxo.clicks.mlsend2.com/td/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEyODY4MDcsXCJsXCI6MTQ2MzQ1MzMyNjkxNjk4OTM5LFwiclwiOjE0NjM0NTM5NTk2ODAxNzg0N30iLCJzIjoiZTNjNjY1ZjFiMmM3NTQ4NCJ9)
---
|
---
Now let me clear, Friend: sex work _is_ work, and unlike what the Supreme Court thinks, privacy is a Constitutional right._

But the Director of OMB is Russell Vought...**one of the architects of** **Project 2025**._

Project 2025 calls for banning contraceptives, birth control, and pornography. And in many Republican states, it's already becoming the law.

And after I [tweeted](https://jjajxo.clicks.mlsend2.com/td/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEyODY4MDcsXCJsXCI6MTQ2MzQ1MzMyNjk0ODQ0NjY4LFwiclwiOjE0NjM0NTM5NTk2ODAxNzg0N30iLCJzIjoiZGU5Y2RkMDljOTU2YWY4YSJ9) it out, something funny happened:**

He deleted his account.**__
|
---
| [ ](https://jjajxo.clicks.mlsend2.com/td/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEyODY4MDcsXCJsXCI6MTQ2MzQ1MzMyNjk3OTkwMzk3LFwiclwiOjE0NjM0NTM5NTk2ODAxNzg0N30iLCJzIjoiYTY1MjU4OTIxOTE3NGIzZCJ9)
---
|
---
_**[Friend, this far-right takeover of our government is dangerous. But it's also funny, because they don't even believe in what they're doing. All that matters to them is the cruelty. I don't know why it took Path to Progress a quick search to reveal this news before any other source, but we did it. It's just another example of how we're connecting with Gen Z on what matters to them, because let's face it, we don't see eye-to-eye with the 78-year old groper-in-chief on reproductive rights.](https://jjajxo.clicks.mlsend2.com/td/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEyODY4MDcsXCJsXCI6MTQ2MzQ1MzMyNzAxMTM2MTI2LFwiclwiOjE0NjM0NTM5NTk2ODAxNzg0N30iLCJzIjoiZmJkMTE3ZGZkNmQ2OWM5ZSJ9)**_
|
---
Friend, I hope you're having a lovely Valentine's Day, no matter who you're spending it with, and unlike Russell Vought, I hope you're proud of your sexuality.**[If you support our work, I'm asking for as little as $5 to keep Path to Progress going and holding these creeps accountable.](https://jjajxo.clicks.mlsend2.com/td/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEyODY4MDcsXCJsXCI6MTQ2MzQ1MzMyNzA1MzMwNDMxLFwiclwiOjE0NjM0NTM5NTk2ODAxNzg0N30iLCJzIjoiODc0MDZlOWFkMTk5MWJlMCJ9)**__

| | _**New Leadership for the Indiana GOP**_
---
Friends, This is my first time sharing my thoughts as your State Chairwoman. I am honored and humbled by the trust placed in me by Governor Mike Braun and the State Committee. I am a proud Hoosier—born and raised. As an entrepreneur, former CFO, and IT Director of a national warehousing company, I have always maintained a full professional schedule. However, service has always been a priority in my life. Since 2016, I have had the honor of serving as Fort Wayne City Clerk—a role I will continue while serving as Chairwoman. In this position, I have worked to modernize and rebuild the office, making local government more transparent and accessible. One of my first initiatives was digitizing and scanning decades of legislative records, ensuring that residents could easily access information about their government and how taxpayer dollars are being spent. This same commitment to transparency, accessibility, and service will guide my leadership at the Indiana Republican Party. Indiana is the crossroads of America, and as Governor Braun reminded us in his State of the State address, we are at a crossroads. As a party, we will continue to work to elect conservative leaders to guide our state and serve our communities. T Together, we will meet the challenges ahead and make Indiana a beacon of freedom and opportunity. Thank you for being a part of our Indiana GOP team, please do not hesitate to reach out if I can ever be of assistance.
---
| |
---
| | Lana Keesling, Indiana GOP Chairwoman

I am honored and humbled by the trust placed in me by Governor Mike Braun and the State Committee. I am a proud Hoosier—born and raised. As an entrepreneur, former CFO, and IT Director of a national warehousing company, I have always maintained a full professional schedule. However, service has always been a priority in my life. Since 2016, I have had the honor of serving as Fort Wayne City Clerk—a role I will continue while serving as Chairwoman. In this position, I have worked to modernize and rebuild the office, making local government more transparent and accessible. One of my first initiatives was digitizing and scanning decades of legislative records, ensuring that residents could easily access information about their government and how taxpayer dollars are being spent. This same commitment to transparency, accessibility, and service will guide my leadership at the Indiana Republican Party. Indiana is the crossroads of America, and as Governor Braun reminded us in his State of the State address, we are at a crossroads. As a party, we will continue to work to elect conservative leaders to guide our state and serve our communities. I know that, for many people, thinking about politics right now is overwhelming

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/102147356/528238415/-240735101?refcode=email-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NTc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MzQ1YjQ4NS0xN2ViLWVmMTEtOTBjYi0wMDIyNDgyYTk0ZjQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=E7QEHnmtDMGInL_e4UvYFRMxeGvCluVDEFq7RRN8Bcw=) I know that, for many people, thinking about politics right now is overwhelming. With all the extremism and chaos that’s going on around us, it’s reasonable to feel dispirited right now. But the people of Kansas didn’t elect me to sit on my hands and become demoralized. They elected me to get things done and fight for families across our state, no matter what party is in charge. subject: The Mountain Minute: 2/14/2025 💕
body:
Three-term Republican state Rep. Rod Bockenfeld has died
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-xlg/s0j8a203c84)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-xlg/s9p2c72346d)**
| | Happy Valentine’s Day, Rocky Mountain Voice family! ❤️
Today is a reminder to cherish the people who make life meaningful—our families, friends, and the communities we fight for every day. Love isn’t just a feeling; it’s action, courage, and commitment. So let’s keep standing for truth, freedom, and each other. Wishing you a day filled with love and gratitude!

Here is a summary of today's top stories:
**🏛️ Colorado Legislative Session Updates...** Senate Bill 3, one of the most restrictive firearm bans in the country, advanced after [late-night debates](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-xlg/scmab32cd4c). Senator Barb Kirkmeyer criticized an amendment to SB 3 that [exempts filmmakers](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-xlg/s3had09a1a7), allowing them to use firearms that would be illegal for Coloradans to own. Republicans argue this contradicts the bill’s intent and exposes legislative hypocrisy.

Senate Bill 5, eliminating secret ballots in some [union elections](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-xlg/s1q009bb912), advanced despite GOP opposition, with critics calling it forced unionization. House Bill 1098, creating a [crime victim alert system](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-xlg/sbmb491496a), moved forward without Republican support over concerns of government overreach. Meanwhile, House Bill 1145, banning the [trafficking of minors for reproductive services](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-xlg/s5v6841c4bf), was rejected. ****
**🏔️ Here in Colorado...** Three-term Republican state [Rep. Rod Bockenfeld has passed away](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-xlg/s6m09b55491) after battling a brain tumor. He was known for his leadership in law enforcement policy and years of public service. Also, the DEA arrested [multiple high-profile criminals](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-xlg/s0v960925e8) in Colorado, now in ICE custody.
🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** The Senate [confirmed RFK Jr.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-xlg/sake99663fa) as HHS Secretary, signaling a shift in health policy. Meanwhile, a report revealed [HHS spent $22 billion on migrant grants](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-xlg/scv2c0c5eb6), including cars, home loans, and startups, sparking concerns over government spending.
This is the Mountain Minute for Friday, February 14, 2025.
– Heidi Ganahl

**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Three-term Republican state Rep. Rod Bockenfeld has died](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-xlg/s0he2c9e73f)** BY BRIAN PORTER, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-xlg/sbp62ab50ff)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-xlg/s5gb480f191)
Rod Bockenfeld, who served Colorado’s House District 56 for three terms, has died, Sen. Rod Pelton announced Thursday to the Colorado Senate.
“He was my representative for two years,” Pelton said. “We sat next to each other in the House chamber, and we became really close. He was a great man.”
Bockenfeld moved to Colorado in 1978 and began a career as a financial crimes investigator. He earned a bachelor’s in law enforcement administration and a graduate degree in banking.

**[Sponsors offer some concessions, but SB 3 still ‘infringement,’ Republicans argue](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-xlg/sdkadaac880)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-xlg/s4lfa3af4fe)
* Senate Bill 3, banning certain semiautomatic firearms, advanced in a late-night vote. While Democrats argue it will reduce gun violence, Republicans claim it infringes on Second Amendment rights and does not address crime.
* An amendment to SB 3 [allows filmmakers to use banned firearms](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-xlg/sao85b829f3) as props, drawing criticism from Republicans who call it hypocritical and undermining the bill’s intent.
* Sponsors added exemptions for 40 specific firearms and included firearm safety training requirements, but Republicans argue the bill still restricts law-abiding gun owners while doing little to curb criminal activity.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-xlg/sav1ada348c)**
|
---
**[In shift from ‘system of choice to coercion,’ Senate Republicans outnumbered in fight on SB 5](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-xlg/s4l7958dfa1)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-xlg/s6q27947281)
* The bill, eliminating the requirement for a second union election, passed in a voice vote despite Republican efforts to introduce amendments. Critics argue it shifts Colorado’s labor system from choice to coercion.
* Republicans warn the bill forces workers to pay union dues, even if they disagree with union policies. Sen. Scott Bright called it “undemocratic,” while Sen. Barb Kirkmeyer pushed for an amendment allowing employees to opt out.
* The Colorado Chamber of Commerce opposes SB 5, arguing it harms the state’s economic competitiveness. GOP lawmakers fear the bill will drive businesses out of Colorado, with some companies already considering relocation.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-xlg/s9v7b30eccc)**
|
---
**[Rep. Bottoms’ HB 1145, prohibiting trafficking of minors into state for reproductive services, killed in committee](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-xlg/s2r0e99d8b2)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-xlg/sbs41b8cdb4)
* The bill, which sought to prohibit the trafficking of minors into Colorado for reproductive services, was defeated in a 7-4 party-line vote, with Democrats arguing it was an anti-choice measure.
* Supporters, including Rep. Scott Bottoms, framed it as a child protection bill, citing cases of minors undergoing multiple procedures, while opponents called it an attack on abortion and transgender rights.
* Lawmakers opposing the bill emphasized their commitment to reproductive rights and LGBTQ protections, with one representative calling her "no" vote a proud stand against perceived anti-choice legislation.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-xlg/sau58c76b3e)**
|
---
**[HB 1098, the crime victim alert system bill, advances, but without Republican committee support. Here’s why.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-xlg/sbs61ee634b)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-xlg/sfmbf40d38a)
* HB 1098, which would create an automated system to notify crime victims of case updates, passed the House Judiciary Committee but lost nearly all Republican support.
* The bill’s estimated $500,000 implementation cost and $250,000 annual maintenance raised fiscal concerns. Gun rights advocates also warned it could unintentionally impact firearm owners under protective orders.
* GOP lawmakers, including Rep. Ryan Armagost, argued the bill could be weaponized through overly broad protection orders, potentially restricting gun rights unfairly.

| Peter,

Happy Valentine’s Day! Our Commonwealth’s motto is Virginia is for lovers, and today, I’m reminded of the deep love we all share for Virginia — a place that’s close to my heart. From the breathtaking Blue Ridge Mountains to the vibrant streets of Richmond to the beauty of our rivers and coastline, Virginia truly is a Commonwealth for lovers. **❤️**

Virginia is where my family put down roots when I was a child, where I went to public school, graduated from college, and later built a life with my husband, Adam, and our three girls. Virginia is also where I began my career in public service, and my love for the Commonwealth and its people is what drove me to run for Congress in 2018.

In Congress, I worked every day to lower prescription drug costs, rebuild our infrastructure, support our Veterans, and defend our fundamental rights. I had the honor of serving Virginia’s Seventh District through extraordinary — and often tough — moments in history, and with that same passion, I’m ready to tackle the challenges ahead as Virginia’s next Governor.

The road ahead won’t be easy, but I’m no stranger to a tough race. With the strength of our grassroots support and your help, I know we can accomplish anything.

body:
For believing in me & granting me the privilege of leading this great state.

|
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/102147855/528240118/823540626?refcode=ea.1d574c55-1aeb-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&ms=ea.1d574c55-1aeb-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODE3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZDU3NGM1NS0xYWViLWVmMTEtOTBjYi0wMDIyNDgyYTk0ZjQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=W1nAzvpcsv-T5a1RSqoiCS-zDuQiW8wClqPR8OMg8bw=&emci=ebb7ee05-40ea-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&emdi=1d574c55-1aeb-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&ceid=1049176)
Peter, During my time in office, I was privileged to work alongside so many steadfast and dedicated public servants who love North Carolina. Governing a state well requires teamwork. All that we accomplished — from enacting Medicaid Expansion to building our clean energy economy — was only possible because of the many people who committed their careers to creating a better North Carolina. Getting the opportunity to lead our state and serve with these amazing people these past eight years has been an extraordinary honor. **You have been important to our success, Peter.** Being born here was luck, but being Governor of North Carolina became possible because people like you came together, with God’s guidance and blessings, to help me. It’s not easy to unseat an incumbent governor, but that’s what we did when I ran in 2016. That year, and again in 2020, we won critical victories even when Donald Trump carried the state. That wouldn’t have happened if folks like you hadn’t joined me in the fight. Thank you for your help as supporters during my campaigns for governor and throughout the past eight years. **Together we have made a difference.[We put together a website where you can look back on some of our achievements, and I hope you’ll take a minute to look at the videos and read about them.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/102147856/528240119/-1148246654?refcode=ea.1d574c55-1aeb-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&ms=ea.1d574c55-1aeb-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODE3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZDU3NGM1NS0xYWViLWVmMTEtOTBjYi0wMDIyNDgyYTk0ZjQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=W1nAzvpcsv-T5a1RSqoiCS-zDuQiW8wClqPR8OMg8bw=&emci=ebb7ee05-40ea-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&emdi=1d574c55-1aeb-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&ceid=1049176)** While I’m proud of all we’ve accomplished so far, I know there’s more work ahead for our state and our country, and I know it won’t be easy. I’m grateful to have you with me. Very truly yours, Roy Cooper [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/102147857/528240120/-1148246654?refcode=ea.1d574c55-1aeb-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&ms=ea.1d574c55-1aeb-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODE3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZDU3NGM1NS0xYWViLWVmMTEtOTBjYi0wMDIyNDgyYTk0ZjQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=W1nAzvpcsv-T5a1RSqoiCS-zDuQiW8wClqPR8OMg8bw=&emci=ebb7ee05-40ea-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&emdi=1d574c55-1aeb-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&ceid=1049176)

| | Dear Fellow Conservative, Chloe Cole was just 13 years old when doctors at Kaiser Permanente fast-tracked her into "transitioning" from a girl to a boy. Chloe was given weekly testosterone injections. She was given experimental drugs used to chemically castrate sex offenders. And finally, at age 15, doctors removed Chloe's healthy breasts in a radical double mastectomy. These doctors never once told Chloe's parents that roughly 80% of kids suffering from "gender dysphoria" grow out of it by the end of puberty... ...or about the horrifying, life-long side effects of these experimental treatments and mutilating surgeries. **Chloe Cole and hundreds of children like her have been used as lab rats by the gender industrial complex.** It's horrifying. But today you can help me stop this from happening by completing the**[Informed Citizens Survey on Transgender Ideology:](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=srp02q&__onlt=h)**
---
[](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=srp02q&__onlt=h)
---
My name is Mark Trammell and I'm the General Counsel and Executive Director of the Center for American Liberty -- the non-profit law firm leading the charge to defend the rights of parents, children, and families to SAY NO to the transgender agenda. As the father of two young children -- a girl and a boy -- I'm very concerned about how deep the radical transgender ideology is infiltrating our country. From the classroom to social media and seemingly innocuous children’s television shows -- it's everywhere. That's why I'm so proud the Center for American Liberty represents Chloe Cole and two other girls in their legal battles against the doctors and hospitals that mutilated them without informed consent. We also represent parents whose children have been secretly "socially transitioned" at school. Our cases are at various stages of the legal process. But we've already won a major parental rights case in California and have another pending on appeal at the Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals. And while President Trump has directed the federal government to recognize only two sexes -- male and female... ...he can't change state and local policies like California's 2024 law that bans school districts from passing parental notification laws when their child begins using different pronouns at school. That's why I'm seeking 1,000 patriots from each state to complete the **[**Informed Citizens Survey on Transgender Ideology**](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=srp02q&__onlt=h)** today. As a non-profit organization, the Center for American Liberty does not receive a dime from the government. And we don't have the deep pockets of the ACLU. That's why it's critical we reach more Americans with the truth about radical transgender ideology -- and what your rights are. In fact, we rely on the support of grassroots American patriots like you to power our efforts inside the courtroom -- from fighting the gender industrial complex to protecting your constitutional rights. So, after completing the survey, I pray you'll make a tax-deductible donation to help us win critical cases on behalf of Chloe Cole and so many others. No matter what, I'm counting on you to help by sharing your opinion in the [**Informed Citizens Survey on Transgender Ideology..**.](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=srp02q&__onlt=h) To protect children from the radical transgender ideology, we need to inform our fellow patriots and sound the alarm. And that starts today with your answers to this survey. Thank you in advance for your help.
---
| | Sincerely, Mark Trammell Executive Director & General Counsel

Jason Crow For Congress [https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/88523/images/logoJC%20(1).png]
I know what it’s like to struggle to make ends meet.

I grew up in a working class family, worked minimum-wage jobs, and joined the Army to pay for my education. I’ve worked long hours in tough conditions, wondering if my paycheck would stretch far enough. That’s why I’m fighting so hard to build an economy that works for everyone — not just the ultra-wealthy.

But Donald Trump and his billionaire allies have a different vision. They’re pushing tax breaks for the rich while working families fall further behind. They’re protecting corporate profits instead of making life more affordable for everyday people.

I won’t stand by and let them rig the system against working people. But to keep up this fight, I need your help before our mid-quarter fundraising deadline tonight at midnight. Can you chip in right now to support my campaign? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc-em-feb25]

I’m in this fight because I know what’s at stake. But I need you on my team.

## Fight Fight Fight...
I hope you saw the story above about the my case involving Joe Biden and the Naval Academy.
I don't think I have ever said this before but its a great read (this may also be the last time I promote The Washington Post).
But there is a larger lesson that the story doesn't tell.
The need to fight - and to fight back (figuratively to the lefties who read this).
In the past, many on the right would fold like a cheap suit when faced with adversity or a negative story in the media. We'd beg for forgiveness or sheepishly explain why a story wasn't accurate and then beg for a ticket to their media party.
President Trump has taught us to fight back - quite literally.
We all recall him actually getting up after being shot and saying, "fight, fight, fight."
But well before that fateful day he was showing us - and telling us - to fight back. Fight back against the media. Fight back against Big Tech. Fight back against corporate America...

This country faced devastation 7 years ago at Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School in Parkland, Florida where 17 students and staff members’ lives were stolen in a horrific mass shooting.

Just a few days later, I saw an armed police officer patrolling the drop-off line at my daughter's school. I was shocked, scared, and felt hopeless. My daughter on the other hand was oblivious, marching into the school building with her pink unicorn backpack. It became clear at that moment that I must take action.

I joined Moms Demand Action, ran for Congress, became a vocal advocate, and started Their Future PAC, the first and only PAC for kids. But now we face a new challenge with an administration that does not put kids first or care about gun violence prevention.

**_[We need your support as we face off with the dangerous Trump administration to try and protect kids around the country. Can you take action today by donating anything you can to help us raise $10,000 before tonight at midnight?](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqtugzCAXsq7sZtzjXZbUjRpv_BhuhXyZXE75iAbZEwVaiE57LQGnJS9hqGusQJBpD7Dt4lVPulGlwAwHHIzllhZm-uvHqFL0VVy38B3P6uzZJ2qjUxdl9VK30ZhnjQLVhyz5uLUHjEEkWO8ClB46fyJWyyjfT2AqOWljvX9myMCdzGL1LofEJRk2R9Ao1-eLOlkUz3iBwIhCc6YxVt-orlp6m12L0YcVs4aLGCb7tPUqDwx-SNUMArFN7EAfSP4giVQz0UdQgfOBQSo2MOTsNL4OUtlFKvJfL5MUvYgRW_h4lE7CWZkZ7Hc-w2JxnpRHV9tRkrUYiTrt-mO82jWpDrx-PM51f7Oppq664C8X-0oK4QrmfFQHd7ZUFaMrIrWEeOU7BONeV5tfcwvxNLVTSxn4k7ijUz65ISh2j0_7rvKag/4e0/vT2tcWfySPmFg8J1OCzLWw/h1/h001.cTZCOpLIBuRIQjku2AVqdRCWwLI-hFCSKuV31Bfc-z8)_**

As a pediatrician, I’ve seen the direct effects of gun violence on our children as it continues to be the leading cause of death for them. I believe we have a moral imperative to act and I am done waiting for our elected officials to do the right thing. The solutions are not extreme or controversial — they are common sense.

We cannot stand by as the current administration disregards gun violence prevention. We must stand up and fight to have a Kids First Agenda in Washington that will ensure the safety of our children and families.

Peter, it’s Ritchie.

I want to make this short and sweet: **I understand the struggles of New York families because I lived them myself, Peter.**

I grew up in public housing ridden with mold, leaks, vermin, and without consistent heat or water.

All the while, the city was shelling out millions on — _get this_ — a Trump golf course right across from the street from me, _rather than housing for struggling New Yorkers._

They drive me to ensure fair, affordable housing for all.
They drive me to put money in the pockets of working families._**

U.S. Sens. Tommy Tuberville and Katie Britt recently joined U.S. Sen. Rand Paul in introducing a bill to help put power back in the people’s hands instead of the "out-of-control administrative state." Called the Regulations from the Executive in Need of Scrutiny (REINS) Act, the legislation would require congressional approval of any major rule with an economic impact of $100 million or more. Any major rule drafted would require approval by both chambers of Congress and then the president's signature rather than automatically taking effect unless Congress specifically disapproves. According to Britt, the bill would "literally rein in our out-of-control administrative state," which she warned was harmful to Alabamians and wasting taxpayer money.

With over 12,000 employees and an annual statewide impact of $1.1 billion, Alabama’s fishing industry is vital to the state’s economic standing. However, those achievements are under threat from outside sources that could severely damage one of Alabama’s key industries. According to U.S. Senators Tommy Tuberville and Katie Britt, cartels in Mexico have been funding and backing fishermen who are catching American red snapper, smuggling the fish back into Mexico, and then reselling it to American consumers for often a cheaper price than fish caught by American anglers. “Senate Republicans are committed to putting America first, which requires legislation that protects hardworking Americans, including our tremendous Gulf of America red snapper fishermen and food producers in Alabama,” said Britt.

Tommy Tuberville and Katie Britt recently joined U.S. Sen. Rand Paul in introducing a bill to help put power back in the people’s hands instead of the "out-of-control administrative state." Called the Regulations from the Executive in Need of Scrutiny (REINS) Act, the legislation would require congressional approval of any major rule with an economic impact of $100 million or more. Any major rule drafted would require approval by both chambers of Congress and then the president's signature rather than automatically taking effect unless Congress specifically disapproves. According to Britt, the bill would "literally rein in our out-of-control administrative state," which she warned was harmful to Alabamians and wasting taxpayer money. | | Mexican cartels are smuggling Alabama red snapper – Tuberville, Britt fight back with new law With over 12,000 employees and an annual statewide impact of $1.1 billion, Alabama’s fishing industry is vital to the state’s economic standing. However, those achievements are under threat from outside sources that could severely damage one of Alabama’s key industries. ---
Derek, Trump promised to cut costs for families all across the country while he was campaigning for president. We are now almost a month into his presidency and instead of cutting costs he has:
* Rescinded President Biden’s executive order to lower prescription drug costs for Americans on Medicare and Medicaid.
* Attempted to cut federal spending on assistance programs millions of Americans rely on.
* Enacted tariffs against our allies that will raise the price of everyday goods — from groceries to fuel — for working families.
* And more.

How will this make anything cheaper for working families across the country? **What’s happening right now is not normal. Trump and his billionaire allies are going back on their campaign promises and putting their interests above the interests of the American people.** Here at the DNC, we are committed to building the long-term infrastructure we’ll need to elect Democrats at every level of government — leaders who will check Trump’s power and actually cut costs in their cities, districts, and states. That’s why we’re reaching out today. Your donation today will be another dollar we can invest in fighting for working families, supporting our state parties all over the country, organizing against Trump’s worst policies, and ultimately in winning back Congress in 2026 and the White House in 2028. [**Right now, our average online contribution is about $30. Many give less. Some give more. All that matters is that you are pitching in to help Democrats fight for working families and mobilize and organize against Trump. Peter, You’ve seen the horrifying headlines: with Donald Trump’s blessing, Elon Musk and his minions have gained unprecedented access to our federal government. It’s clearly a disaster for our democracy, with an unelected billionaire seemingly being rewarded with broad authority over our government after spending over $290 million to elect Trump and other Republicans. And it’s also **an emergency for the census** — the foundation for drawing fair electoral maps and ensuring every part of the country gets the resources it needs. You see, in the last two weeks, massive Census Bureau data files _that are normally publicly available_ disappeared from the website. Some of those files have come back online, but this raises concerns about the integrity of this critical data now and going forward. As Trump and Musk try to reshape the federal government to fit their own agenda, we must protect census data from any political manipulation. **Our mapping and analytics team is working hard to compile records of past census data so we can closely watch for any changes, and we’re doing everything we can to defeat attacks on the census and our democracy wherever they arise. ** [**So please, pitch in what you can to the NDRC today to fight for an accurate census, promote fair maps around the country, and help stop the anti-democratic agenda of Trump, Musk, and MAGA extremists.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/102153078/528256627/-1665762292?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_ElonFRCensus_email_20250214-NDRC-Tier1-ElonFRCensus_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20250214-NDRC-Tier1-ElonFRCensus_&utm_campaign=ElonFRCensus&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjZjZjg4NWY5LTJjZWItZWYxMS05MGNiLTAwMjI0ODJhOTRmNCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=6ZUkkI6lBBtiq8nNMkmQHm_m3GY_pm3fZQqecdYdH7o=) The fair maps movement protected the 2020 Census from Trump in his first term, and we’ll be prepared no matter what his team throws at us this time around. **Together, we can make it clear: our census data and our democracy are not for sale — _not now, not ever._** | _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_
